en.headline: sogeisetsu: 9 commits, 2 bugs filed, 1 discussion started
en.summary: On 2026-10-14, `sogeisetsu` made **9 own commits** across three repositories, plus 21 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`, 5 commits removed `/asset-inventory` slash-command references from skill, contributor docs, READMEs, guides, and samples, corrected skill invocation facts in the rule and all samples, and cut the `v1.15.4` release. In `sogeisetsu/myBlog`, 3 commits added OpenChamber capture samples: `desktop-1440x900.jpg`, `panel-region-1to1.png`, and `mobile-390x844.jpg`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 1 own commit added truncation labeling to the daily report and AI summary when collection hits the cap. Two issues were opened in `openchamber/openchamber`: #4899 on browser captures exporting at CSS pixel size (1x) on a 200% display, and #4896 on the missing UI affordance to unlink an agent-linked issue or PR. `openchamber-bot[bot]` replied to both, marking each as `fix-ready` with the cause traced. A discussion was also started in `openchamber/openchamber` (#4893) titled "Picked attachments are dropped for text-only models - fall back to a path reference". No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu：9 次提交，2 个 bug，1 个讨论
zh.summary: 2026-10-14，`sogeisetsu` 在三个仓库共完成 **9 次本人提交**，另有 21 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中的自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 中，5 次提交移除了 skill、贡献者文档、README、指南和示例中的 `/asset-inventory` 斜杠命令引用，修正了 rule 及所有示例中的 skill 调用事实，并发布 `v1.15.4`。在 `sogeisetsu/myBlog` 中，3 次提交新增了 OpenChamber 截图样本：`desktop-1440x900.jpg`、`panel-region-1to1.png` 和 `mobile-390x844.jpg`。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，1 次本人提交为日报与 AI 摘要在采集命中上限时增加了截断标注。在 `openchamber/openchamber` 中开出了两个 issue：#4899 关于浏览器截图在 200% 显示下以 CSS 像素尺寸（1x）导出，#4896 关于无法在 UI 中解除 agent 关联的 issue 或 PR。`openchamber-bot[bot]` 对两者均回复，标记为 `fix-ready` 并追溯了原因。此外在 `openchamber/openchamber` 发起了讨论 #4893，标题为 "Picked attachments are dropped for text-only models - fall back to a path reference"。当日无 PR、review 或 release 记录。
